BiblicalUsage: Three is the Bible's number for waiting, for witness, and for deliverance. Joseph told the butler that the three branches are three days, Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights, and Esther asked her people to fast for her three days, night or day.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that three is the number of waiting in the Bible, and every three days in it ends with God moving.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Jonah; Queen Esther
